title: Quran Lahu Me Doob Gaya
body:
Quran Lahu Me Doob Gaya-Quran Lahu Me Doob Gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Laasha Padha Hai Run Me Jo Haaye Abbas-e-Bawafa Ka
1.Baazu Howe Khalam Jo saqqa-e-Karbala Ke
Mashkiza Chedh Daala Teer-e-Sitam Ne Haaye
Gudhe Se Sar Ke Bal Jo Haaye Gaazi Zameen Pe Aaya
<<MINI>>
Quran Lahu Me Doob Gaya Quran Lahu Me Doob Gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
2.Sab Aakhruba Ke Laashe Run Me Padhe Howe Hai
Shabbir Qatilou Me Tanha Khade Howe Hai
Zainab Yeh Roke Kheti Hai Haaye Tanha Hai Mera Bhaiya
<<MINI>>
Quran Lahu Me Doob Gaya Quran Lahu Me Doob Gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
3.Maidan Me Chodh Aaye Bhai Ki Laash Sarwar
Abbas Ne Wasiyath Ki Thi Yeh Waqt-e-Aakhir
Mashk-o-Alam Toh Aaye Haaye Laasha Na Ghar Me Aaya
<<MINI>>
Quran Lahu Me Doob Gaya Quran Lahu Me Doob Gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
4.Paani Ku Haaye Chote Bache Taras Rahe Hai
Karbal Ke Aasman Se Shole Baras Rahe Hai
Pyasi Sakina Padhti Hai Haaye Roro Ke Bus Yeh Nouha
<<MINI>>
Quran Lahu Me Doob Gaya Quran Lahu Me Doob Gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
5.Zainab Ke Laal Run Me Sar Ku Kaata Chuke Hai
Shabbir Bhanjou ke Laashe Utha Chuke Hai
Betou Ki Maiyyatou Pe Ab Haaye Maa Kar Chuki Hai Sajda
<<MINI>>
Quran Lahu Me Doob Gaya Quran Lahu Me Doob Gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
6.Jhule Se Run Me Aakar Gardan Pe Teer Khakar
Nanhi Ki Qabr Me Hai Bechain Haaye Asghar
Turbat Se Ab Nikal Kar Sar Denga Jhule Wala
<<MINI>>
Quran Lahu Me Doob Gaya Quran Lahu Me Doob Gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
7.Bhai Ke Gham Sheh Ki Tudti Howi Kamar Hai
Bete Ke Gham Me Yarab Tudhta Howa Jigar Hai
Sab Mar Chuke Hai Aakhruba Haaye Tanha Hai Shahe Wala
<<MINI>>
Quran Lahu Me Doob Gaya Quran Lahu Me Doob Gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
8.Tudhti Hai Ek Qayamath Karbobala Ke Bun Me
Be Aas Ho chuki Hai Aale Rasool Run Me
Qaime Me Shahe Deen Ke Haaye Mehshar Hai Ek Barpa
<<MINI>>
Quran Lahu Me Doob Gaya Quran Lahu Me Doob Gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
9.Khwab-e-Khaleel Ku Ab Tabir Mil Chuki Hai
Meethi Me Mustafa Ki Tasweer Mil Chuki Hai
Kandhe Pe Hai Hussain Ke Haaye Run Me Pisar Ka Laasha
<<MINI>>
Quran Lahu Me Doob Gaya Quran Lahu Me Doob Gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
10.Aahle Aza Ke Dil Par Taaza Yeh Gham Hasan Hai
Har Matami Ju Sar Par Bhandhe Howe Kafan Hai
Hargis Na Ab Rukenga Yeh Karwan Aza Ka
<<MINI>>
Quran Lahu Me Doob Gaya Quran Lahu Me Doob Gaya
